findings.title: Escape every JSON control byte in error strings
findings.mechanism: The unchanged emit helper flattens CR/LF then uses Lua5.1 %q. Actual9e probe_refused error text contains four literal traceback TAB bytes, so all three ground.jsonl files fail strict Python JSON parsing on row2 column122. Lua quoting is not a JSON string encoder for all control bytes. The driver advertises JSON Lines but its reached refusal path is malformed; this can prevent downstream audit of failed/unsupported characterization.
findings.bounded_correction: Use a JSON string encoder that correctly escapes quote, backslash and every byte0..31 (prefer lossless escaping rather than erasing diagnostic content). Apply it to the affected driver keys/values. Add strict real-script controls containing all control bytes plus quote/backslash and traceback tabs, verifying semantic string preservation and actual invalid/failure disposition. Preserve all three original malformed raw files and their hashes; do not normalize/rewrite them into valid old output.
findings.evidence: Strict parsing performed against all three actual retained files; byte counts, exact errors and hashes below. Forensic strict=False decoding was used only to inspect known invalid artifacts, not to accept them as valid JSON or measurements.
